title: SLOW SUNDAY
prompt: Sunday used to be a whole day | It takes eight minutes | You cannot rush it, so you do not | SLOW SUNDAY - nowhere to be
style: warm documentary photography, morning kitchen light, natural textures, soft shadows, muted earthy palette, shallow depth of field, high detail
line: Sunday used to be a whole day. Slow Sunday is a coarse ground for a slow brew. It takes eight minutes. That is the point. You cannot rush it, so you do not. Slow Sunday. Nowhere to be.
